name: Elocution
summary: Conversation isn't usually considered a formal Discipline, but a Rhetorician would disagree. Further, that disagreement might just win you over.

attrs.passive:
You can add your Elocution to the roll when you Preempt.
When speaking with a Creature, you can pick a Topic (a subject or specific conversation) and learn their subjective "Temperature" about it. Temperature tells you the strength of their emotions about the Topic. The hotter, the stronger. This doesn't tell you if the emotions are necessarily positive or negative, but you do not have to mention to Topic at all to gain this.
You can gain this information for the same Creature about a number of Topics up to your Elocution.

feats.name: Humourism
feats.effect: When speaking with a Creature, you can pick a Topic (a subject or specific conversation) and learn their subjective "Temperature" about it. Temperature tells you the strength of their emotions about the Topic. The hotter, the stronger. This doesn't tell you if the emotions are necessarily positive or negative, but you do not have to mention to Topic at all to gain this.

feats.name: Whistling in the Dark
feats.effect: When an Ally suffers Panic Risk, you Communicate with them, granting them Resilience to Stress from it, up to your Elocution.
feats.flavor: You should have seen the other guy

feats.name: Daring
feats.effect: The Disposition of a Target is increased by 1 regarding Topics with a high Temperature, and their Attitude is better by 1 about those with low Temperature.

feats.name: Good Humour
feats.effect: When an Ally benefits from your Whistling in the Dark and does not Panic, they shed 1 Strain.

feats.name: Nudging
feats.effect:
When speaking with a Creature for longer than 1 Minute, you can temporary raise or lower their Temperature related to a Topic, consequently blunting or heightening their emotional responses related to it.
When engaging in any Activity about a Topic with especially high Temperature (implying it was already high and then you increased it), their Disposition cannot fall below 1, allowing you to keep them talking for as long as you'd like.

name: Faith
summary: Not all magic was disrupted by the Doom. The Priests never depended on the Aether for their abilities. Instead, a priest is Elected to serve a Deity. Within Verdun Noble Families, the first-born children inherit a Priestly role on their Name Day. Thereafter, they must choose a Deity to serve.

attrs.passive:
You have the ability to Bless anything which is not Unholy, be it an Object, a Creature, a Space, an act, a ceremony, even a concept. This is an open-ended effect, with some concrete guidelines as follows:
After 1 Minute of Touch, it becomes Holy. If this is a corpse, it ceases decaying and cannot be used to raise an Undead. Any attempt reduces it to fragrant ashes instead.
After a 1 AP Interaction, they gain a Boon which they can spend on anything they wish within the next Day.
After 1 Hour of incantation, the first Unholy Creature that enters it without permission suffers Moderate Panic, or 2d6 Strain if they are Mindless.
As a 1 AP Reaction, you can allow a Creature you Detect to reroll a Test. Each time you do so in a day after the first you lose 1 Virtue.
The terms and norms of any formal agreement or expectation of the participants become Binding. Priests who break it lose 2d6 Virtue and others suffer 1d6 Corruption. All participants intrinsically understand if an intention would break these before they take them. Likewise, unless the breaker is Unholy, all participants know the instant it is broken.
This becomes an Ideal for you or for a Creature that swears it to you. When acting for their Ideal, they can gain the effects of Invoking their Archetype, but actions that would violate it incur the effects of breaking a Ceremony, as above.
This is not the limit of what can be Blessed. At GM discretion, a Priest can Bless anything at all. What this does should roughly mirror the above, but more drastic effects are possible, especially if the course of action serves your Deity. For example, Priests of Bella can heal trivial hurts with a Touch, Lumenary Priests can create harmless candle-lights, etc. Blessings imbue with Divinity, something at once frightening, mysterious, and hopeful in equal respect.

feats.name: Solar Prominence
feats.effect: For the Duration, you radiate an Aura of light with a Radius equal to your Virtue. Allies within it gain a Buff of one to their Reserve while all Creatures with the Unholy Trait become Blind.
feats.flavor: Oh Lumen, fill me with thy Light, invest my body with your radiance.

feats.name: The Secret Fire
feats.effect:
Each night, you gain Sparks equal to your Virtue. These can be spent as a 0 AP Reaction to anything in the following ways:
You or an Ally you Detect gain a Boon to any Test.
You and all Allies within 10 Meters gain the ability to seen in the dark, as if in strong moonlight, for 10 Minutes.
An Ally gains a d6 that they can roll whenever they would take Damage. On a roll of 5 or 6 prevents it. The d6 is spent regardless.
A flicker of silver passes across everything within 10 Meters, lingering where anything has been intentionally hidden or lost.
feats.flavor: Luna, gatherer of the sparks of the Glory, grant me wisdom. Bless my eyes to see the unseen.

feats.name: The Eye of Judgment
feats.effect:
You can never be Blind and gain the following benefits:
When you see a Creature, you know instantly if it is Unholy or Undead.
You automatically Gauge all Unholy and Undead Creatures on sight.
You gain passive awareness of both Holy and Unholy energies within 100 Meters. This can be used to indicate the proximity of fitting Creatures, Objects, or Items, like smell or hearing.
feats.flavor: The Just sees in darkness and pronounces the faults of the guilty, by his grace, so shall I.

feats.name: Last Rites
feats.effect:
When you touch a dead Creature, you can turn its body to fragrent ash, good for soil and even breath as it swirls out from their resting place. Where they were, an Effigy, which is a tiny figure made from cool, but not cold, never-melting ice remains. This is a weak Holy Relic that, when touched, reminds one of happy memories.
When one of your Allies you Detect would Die, you can instantly wrap them in frost, making them totally invulnerable for Rounds equal to your Virtue. While saving them from instant death and further injury for the Duration, they die instantly when the ice evaporates, fragmenting into a shower of beautiful silver sparks, carried on a cold breeze. This death places their Effigy in your hands.
feats.flavor: Kind mistress, silent judge in the darkened paths of the void, hear me. I seek your mercy, your grace and favor. In the end of of the just, grant them nobility and in the end of the ignorant, let there at least be peace.

feats.name: Forge Light
feats.effect:
Your arms constantly radiate soft light, you have a Bonus to your capacity to lift and drag equal to twice your Virtue, and under your Touch, stone and metal have the consistancy of soft clay, bending and warping with no excess heat or damage to their temper. You can adjust this effect at will, gripping a whole sword in one hand, and pressing the other through a stone as if it were butter.
Likewise, this makes your arms and hands nearly indestructible. They cannot be subject to Injury and, further, you can Block using a free hand. This functions as Shield with Hardness equal to your Brawn and thrice your Virtue. You are subject to the Damage if it exceeds this.
Finally, this augmentation to your arms grants your Unarmed Attacks a Bonus to Damage equal to your Virtue.

feats.name: Nous' Inspiration
feats.effect:
You have a pool of Inspiration, equal to your Virtue. This can be spent in any of the following ways:
When you or an Ally make a Test, you can spend Inspiration to grant a Boon, before or after you see the result.
Before making a Test, you can Spend Inspiration to grant yourself a Bonus to the roll.
You can spend 2 or more Inspiration to negate Panic Risk.
You may increase the Disposition of a Target by 1.
All Inspiration is regained when you Catch your Breath, when you or an Ally critically succeeds a Test or exceeds its Difficulty by 3 or more.
feats.flavor: Nous, she that sees our works and tells our histories, let your Inspiration move through me. Let this quicken our hearts, and bring us to great deeds.

feats.name: Purifying Fire
feats.effect:
For the Duration, all Spaces within an Aura centered on you equal to your Virtue are as many steps Warmer for counter-acting Extreme Cold, and all Allies within can subtract your Virtue from Fire Damage or Stress they suffer (including and especially Stress from Panic).
You can Heal any Creature within your Purifying Fire, as if using a Bandage as a Specialized Faith Test. This does not require materials and, if you use more than 1 AP, sheds 1 Strain from the Target.
When you fail to Heal a Target, they suffer Minor Panic Risk.
feats.flavor: Bella, unleash your fire in me, awaken the Breath and ignite your will!

feats.name: Consecration
feats.effect:
You spend an Hour preparing Spaces within a Burst up to 10 times your Virtue. At the conclusion of this time, that area is filled with visible light and gains the following properties.
These Spaces count as Burning for Unholy Creatures..
Creatures that Catch their Breath there can shed 1 Persistant Strain, once per Day.
Infections and Diseases cannot progress within the area.
You can only maintain one such area at a time. If you create another, the previous vanishes. Further, you must repeat the Consecration Daily to maintain it.
feats.flavor: Sun beyond light, one who is the cause of Dawn, fill these stones with your heat, the earth with rays of glory, and abjure the unclean who would dare to trespass holy ground.

feats.name: Sanctuary
feats.effect:
At sunset, you can invoke the Sanctuary Oath. While the Oath remains in place, you gain the following benefits:
When a Creature would attempt any kind of aggression against you, you can Coin-Flip to avoid it completely, no Action required.
You can make peace with any Beast by spending Sparks equal to its Tier. These obey you in loose terms and will not harm you or an Ally. Any aggression or an order intended to harm it breaks this effect.
The first effect you spend Sparks on each Round has a reduced cost by 1.
The Oath is broken on your part if you take any action intended to harm a Creature, unless they are Unholy.
feats.flavor: Night Mother, peace bearer, hear this oath. I will harm none I see, so let those who would repay me with hatred be repaid in kind, let their weapons fall to the cool earth, let only repentance save them from you.

feats.name: Lightning Strike
feats.effect: Strike with a Weapon, dealing additional Voltaic Damage and Stunning the Target for 1 Round, miss or hit; this stacks with the Stun from Voltaic Damage and increases the Stun Tier by 1. If the Target is Unholy or Undead, you can use your Virtue for the Damage Tier. If this Injures or kills an Unholy or Undead, you shed 1 Strain.
feats.flavor: Holy Justice, hear your servant, deliver your wrath, swift and clear.

feats.name: Death Rime Invocation
feats.effect:
Everything within a T Meter Aura centered on you is encrusted in Death Rime, Mora's essence manifest. While covered in Death Rime, the Undead suffer Strain Frost Damage equal to your Virtue, and your Allies gain an equal Bonus to their DT.
If an Ally would die from the terminal effect of Last Rites within Range, roll a Chaos Die. On faces 1-2, they become Incapacitated instead.
feats.flavor: She Inevitable, pale and glorious, witness me. Let your presence invest the air with frost, the harbinger of your Paler Will. She merciless, she without discrimination, Mora of lights silver and bright, witness me.

feats.name: Soulcasting
feats.effect:
You can exchange the materials of Objects you Touch, changing one to another. The mechanics of the change follow the Primal Ring, which are the structure of Elements which Manus' Priests espouse to be the root of all things. The ring is made from the following five Elements:
These stand in a loop, with Water adjacent to Crystal. At the center of the Ring lies the sixth Element:
When you change something, first identify the strongest consistuent Element; Stone for rocks, Wood for a plank, Metal for a blade, etc. The result is an identically shaped re-imagining of the Target made from a pure form of an adjacent Element in the Ring. Life is an immutable Element, situated appart from the rest. For this reason, you cannot transmute a Creature, living, Undead, Demon, Celestial, etc.
When changing a thing, you can also decide the Phase of the Element, provided that Extreme Heat or Cold generated would not exceed your Virtue.
Plants present a unique exception to the immutability of Life, given that their principle Elements are Wood and Water in equal measure, with Life as a tertiary compound. This means that you can miraculously exchange the substance of a plant while leaving its Life unchanged, producing a Magical plant made from a different Element. Flowers of gold, trees made from granite, and grass formed from ice are all possible applications of this Prayer.
Finally, their are obstructions to Soulcasting. Materials that are Unholy, Magical, and otherwise unnatural, Arcane, Demonic, or otherwise estranged from the natural world cannot be effected. Likewise, while drinkable water can be made, edible food is impossible, because food's nutritive power stems from a complex blend of all Elements, and the results of Soulcasting are pure.
feats.flavor: King of the Forge whose Light dwells in my hand, bathe these materials with your power and attend them to me. I call the Elements within and bid them obey, to change and become something new.

feats.name: World's Stage
feats.effect: For the Duration, within an Aura centered on you with a Radius up to your Virtue, all Tests made by Allies and yourself gain a Bonus of 1, and when subject to a Melee Attack, you can spend 2 Inspiration to reduce the roll by your Virtue. If this would make it a critical failure, you regain Inspiration.
feats.flavor: Keeper of stories, heavenly Witness, see me now. Look on our efforts and shine your favor on our bravery.

feats.name: Hearth Emmenation
feats.effect:
By spending 10 Minutes in incantation, you can invoke a Hearth Emmenation, a harmless cherry-red mote of fire, within Engagement. Hearth Emmenations radiate the Aura from your Purifying Flame and, within that area confer the following effects:
Unholy Creatures suffer Extreme Heat at the Tier of your Virtue unless you invite them in.
All Creatures benefit from a Rest as if they had spent an additional point of Opportunity, and shed 1 point of Corruption per Rest.
You can dispel and forbid any Magical effects of a Tier less than your Virtue.
Hearth Emmenations persist until you dismiss them.
feats.flavor: Merciful Daughter, Hearthmaiden of the above, I seek a spark from the greater flame.

feats.name: Holy Rebuke
feats.effect: When a Creature in your Prominence Attacks an Ally, you inflict the Unholy Trait on them for the Duration. If they already had that Trait, they suffer Damage as if within your Consecration.
feats.flavor: Light of lights, I seek the grace to administer your justice.

feats.name: The Door in the Night
feats.effect:
By spending 1 Minute, you can open a Door anywhere not in direct light. Doors all lead to the Evernight, which takes the form of a secluded wood at night. No living thing but plants can be seen there, Silverwoods above and Nightblooms below, and nothing edible grows within. However, its streams are full of clean, natural water.
From the Evernight, you can exit through any existing Door you conjure, allowing nearly instantaneous travel. You can have Doors up to your Faith there, and can banish any you wish at any time. Doors can be seen through from the Evernight, and affix to Spaces (moving when the Space does.) The Doors a Priest of Luna conjures are unique, and can only be accessed by them or Allies they lead through them.
When strong light like day or a lamp falls on a Door, it becomes invisible and intangible. You can also render any Door you create invisible and intangible as a 1 AP Interaction from the Evernight.
For 6 Sparks, you can recall a Door that you have previously banished.
feats.flavor: Luna, protector of travelers, open a way into your shaded hall. Give us safe passage and respite.

feats.name: Holy Vigor
feats.effect: Each dawn, you gain a number of Blessings up to your Virtue. Blessings can be spent to grant a Creature you touch a Buff to any Ability, up to the amount spent. If spent on a Creature other than you, the Buff is increased by 1. Likewise, Blessings can be spent to remove 1 point of Strain from any Creature you Touch, and 3 can be spent to heal a non-Magical Disease.
feats.flavor: Guardian of the Good, protect us, gird our legs so that we might stand tall, harden our backs and arms so that we may strike true, and fill us with your fervor, so that we might not fall into corruption.

feats.name: Mortal Blade
feats.effect: During Death Rime Invocation, you can Touch a Weapon as a 1 AP Interaction, making it a Holy Mortal Blade which increasing its Reach by 1 and adding Frost Damage for the Duration. All Undead are Vulnerable to Frost Damage from Mortal Blades, equal to the Virtue of their creator.
feats.flavor: I call the Scythe, reaper's instrument, make mine like yours, a blade sharp as the Paler Will.

feats.name: Inner Light
feats.effect:
For the Duration of this Stance, your Engagement becomes hotter, equal to your Virtue. In turn, you are immune to Extreme Heat below your Virtue, and gain equal Resilience to Fire.
Your Unarmed Attacks inflict Fire Damage, and when you Block with an arm, you can suffer 1 Strain to negate all Damage (You can see the Damage roll before doing so).
feats.flavor: Master of forms and of strength, ignite the flames in me, let the bellows blow and air sing with the heat of your power.

feats.name: Investiture of Hope
feats.effect: While you have Inspiration, you gain an equal Bonus to your Agility and Movement Speed. If you spend all remaining Inspiration on a single Test (for yourself or another Creature) you can make it a Flourish. This confers the effects of a critical success if it succeeds, but does not replenish your Inspiration.
feats.flavor: Nous, daughter of both Start and Conclusion, enliven us with your grace, guide our footsteps and strengthen our arms.

feats.name: Purgation's Flame
feats.effect:
When you Heal an Ally, you can Amplify the power of your flames, both restoring and stripping away rot. This removes 1d6 Strain, but provokes Minor Panic Risk from the pain.
Likewise, if you Heal an Unholy Creature, you can deny it any benefits, inflicting only the Panic of failure. If it is a Mindless Undead, this inflicts 3d6+(your Virtue)d6 Fire Damage.
feats.flavor: Elder, Maiden's watcher, I seek the austerity of your will, with which I may dispel rot and banish the wicked.

feats.name: Redemption
feats.effect: Creatures without the Unholy Trait shed 1 Strain per Round within both your Prominence and Consecration.
feats.flavor: Source of heat and motion, deliver us from attrition, take the weight from our steps and brighten our eyes with your radience.

feats.name: Silver Pool
feats.effect: By Touching a reflective surface no larger than 1 Meter, you can change its reflection. It can show a view from any other reflective surface you have touched, so long as it is not currently under strong light. If it is, you can reach to the shadow of the mirror instead. This shows a reflection from some other time in the past. This past reflection must be from when the mirror was in darkness.
feats.flavor: Lady in the mirror, who is the mirror and the darkness within, transform this surface. Let this wyrding glass show another place, another time, another face, in the darkness, where your secrets shine.

feats.name: Aura of Heroism
feats.effect: For the Duration of this Stance, you generate an Aura up to half your Virtue centered on yourself. When an Ally in Range is Attacked, they can Resist with your Virtue instead of their Tier/Skills. Likewise, your Melee Range increases by 1 Meter and the Stunning effects of your Smite apply to all Unholy Creatures within Range.
feats.flavor: Telmar, stand by me. Fill my hands with your power, and let my defenses cover those I am bound to protect.

feats.name: Rime Formation
feats.effect:
During Death Rime Invocation, you can use the following Actions:
For 2 AP, you coat a door, gate, or other opening enclosed within your Range in permanent Death Rime. Seals are unbreakable barriers that can only be undone by Arcane Magic or the Blessing of another Priest.
As a Primary Action, you can launch a projectile of sharpened Death Rime at a foe within Meters equal to twice your Virtue. This is a Shot which inflicts Frost and Piercing Damage.
For 1 AP, you can create a barrier within Range. This can occupy Spaces up to your Virtue at once and evaporates when your Death Rime does or when you create another.
As a 2 AP Reaction, you can Block with your Death Rime for anyone in Range. This has no Durability, but has Hardness equal to thrice your Virtue.
feats.flavor: I call the Gate and Nail, those which close the doors of crypts and bind the mouths of sarcophagi. Ice, bind and freeze at the will of your Mistress.

feats.name: Forge Blessing
feats.effect:
When using your Faith to Repair, Items gain bonus Durability and Hardness equal to your Virtue.
Further, you can replicate the effect of any Augmentation Rune when you Repair a Holy Item.
feats.flavor: Lord of the Forge, guide my arms, teach me the ways of beauty, ensure the strength of my works

feats.name: The Promise of Victory
feats.effect: While enclosed within your World's Stage, foes suffer a penalty of 1 to all Tests. Unholy foes suffer twice as much.
feats.flavor: Watcher over time, I give you my vow, we shall triumph today in your name.

feats.name: Lesser Aspect of the Breath of Life
feats.effect:
When you Heal an Ally, you can penalize your Test by 1 to remove a Minor Injury, 2 to remove a Moderate Injury, and 3 to remove a Major Injury. Targets suffer Panic Risk of corresponding Severity from the pain.
Failing to remove an Injury always inflicts Major Panic Risk.
feats.flavor: Bella, she who waits at the end and who is the start of new journeys, instruct me in the intimacies of the fire inside.

feats.name: White Light Armaments
feats.effect: All Allies within your Solar Prominence gain a Magical Shield with a Durability of 3 which does not require the Block Action to benefit from. If this is Broken, it is restored on the start of your next Turn as long as they remain within Range. Likewise, Creatures with one of your Shields deal an additional Incendiary Damage to Unholy Creatures with their Weapons.
feats.flavor: Enemy of corruption and spear against the dark, empower us without holy light. Shine in me.

feats.name: Eyes of the Night
feats.effect: After an Hour long incantation, you can ask the GM a single question about an uncertain coming event. They must answer, but can be reasonably vague. If the event is the result of a dice roll from a table, Coin-Flip, or some other random process, they tell you the result.
feats.flavor: She in the shadow, show me more, open the gates not only of space but also in time. Future sight, dark and terrible, omens spinning and screaming in the sky. She in the shadow, show me more.

feats.name: The Reach of Justice
feats.effect:
If a Target you can percieve with your Eye of Judgement is Unholy or has been lawfully convicted of a heinous crime (equal to murder or treason) you Mark them. This Mark is a visible sign to all and lasts until they have been brought to proper justice.
Creatures Marked in this way are Vulnerable to Damage from Holy Weapons and Prayers, equal to half your Virtue, and cannot benefit from any Resiliences against the same sources of Damage. Likewise, the Mark causes all Targeting Tests to automatically succeed against them.
feats.flavor: Greatest of Judges, look on my circumstance and cause. If I stand to the right of you, make me like the stone and pillar. Cast those to your left into the darkness, let them be trodden under the feet of the just.

feats.name: Silent Rain
feats.effect: All foes within Meters equal to twice your Virtue become Vulnerable equal to twice their own Tier for Minutes equal to your Virtue. When a Vulnerable foe is touched by Death Rime, this stacks with the Vulnerability applied to the Undead, and all Unholy foes suffer 1 Strain.
feats.flavor: Pale lady, take my hand, attend your servant here. Fill the sky with your majesty, our breath with the chill of your scrutiny. See with my eyes and judge the unworthy, for we are ready to execute your designs.

feats.name: Supernova
feats.effect:
When you negate Damage with your Inner Light, you can emit the same amount, as Fire Damage, in a Radius equal to your Virtue, from an Aura centered on yourself.
Further, you do not suffer any Strain if the negated Damage was already Fire.
feats.flavor: King of Creation and of making, protect me, temper my body as steel, and preserve me from all ills.

feats.name: Against all Odds
feats.effect: When you or an Ally critically fails a Test or suffers a Major Injury, you instantly regain all Inspiration.
feats.flavor: Storyteller, in the hour of our doubt, we seek you.

feats.name: Mercy
feats.effect: During your Purifying Fire, you can suffer Panic Risk in the stead of anyone you choose, suffering 1 Strain from the pain instead of needing to roll.
feats.flavor: Watcher at the door and guardian of the home, tell me of that greater wisdom, of the natures of Flame and Breath, of the sythesis of Mercy.

feats.name: The Sun in Splendor
feats.effect:
All darkness within 1,000 Meters is dispelled for 10 Days, illuminating everything as if in perfect daylight (regardless of obstruction.) Within 100 Meters, all Unholy Creatures with a Tier less than yours are Incapacitated and, within 10, they are destroyed and reduced to ashes. The space around you is also Consecrated.
You can also use this Prayer as a Reaction for 0 AP if you would die, even if Helpess, Unconcious, or any other obstruction.
feats.flavor: Lumen, king of heavenly light, dwell in my body. Fill my bones with fire, my flesh with blinding illumination.

feats.name: Mirror Glorious
feats.effect:
For the Duration, you generate 1 Spark each Turn and gain the following new ways to spend them:
An Ally you Detect automatically succeeds a Test. You can spend twice as many to make it critical.
An Enemy you Detect automatically fails a Test. You can spend twice as many to make it critical.
For each Round spent in this Stance past the first each Day, you suffer 1 Strain.
feats.flavor: Luna, queen of air and darkness, dwell in my body. Veil me in your shade, see with my eyes, and utter curses and blessing from my mouth. Wonderous and awful Deity of the night, walk with me.

feats.name: The Dawn Hammer
feats.effect: For the next Minute, you are 1 Size Larger and can use your Virtue as if it were a Skill to Resist anything or make Attacks with any Weapon. Unholy Creatures that begin their Turn within 10 Meters of you must roll a Chaos Die. If they roll a 4 or higher they are compelled to flee.
feats.flavor: Telmar, lord of war and justice, dwell in my body. Walk with my steps, take up arms with my hands and prosecute the unworthy in the name of the Glory.

feats.name: The End
feats.effect:
For Minutes equal to your Virtue, you become intangible, gain a Flying Speed equal to your Virtue, and radiate a Death Rime Invocation of twice the normal size. You cannot act but to Move or use Prayers for the Duration.
Strain from this Action is suffered at the end of its Duration.
feats.flavor: Mora, cold at the end of time, dwell in my body. Where I am, you are, where you were, I am. What you would, I will.

feats.name: The Beginning
feats.effect: An Object or Item with Bulk no greater than your Virtue is conjured into existence, formed from pure Forge Light. The only limitation is that the thing created lacks the Element of Life and cannot be Magical or Unholy.
feats.flavor: Manus, initiator of all things, dwell in my body, let all things heed my voice, speaking in your name, let air become fire, and fire become reality.

feats.name: The Storyteller
feats.effect: For the next Minute, your World's Stage expands, up to 10 times your Virtue. Within this region, all Allies are immune to Panic, and you regenerate 1 Inspiration each Turn. You suffer 6 Strain at the conclusion of this Action.
feats.flavor: Nous, she that tells, dwell in my body, put your voice on my tongue, your words to my speach. Let all who hear that love you rejoice, and those that hate you soon despair.

feats.name: The Hearth Flame
feats.effect:
If a Creature within your Purifying Fire has died within Minutes equal to or less than your Virtue, you can suffer Persistant Strain equal to their Tier to bring them back to full life.
The Target's body must be reasonably intact for this to work, however, you can choose to give your own life in the process to effect a Target with as little connection as a scrap of fabric and whose death is longer gone by a thousand fold.
feats.flavor: Daughter of Beginning and End, dwell in my body, burn in me and walk in my place, see with my eyes and breath with my mouth. Flame of the Heart, make me an instrument of your Mercy

name: Leadership
summary: Good leaders are a rare treasure, one which Trainees of this Discipline hope to achieve. Another time-honored practice, Leadership is a Noble pursuit be convention, but more often achieved elsewhere.
text: Good leaders are a rare treasure, one which Trainees of this Discipline hope to achieve. Another time-honored practice, Leadership is a Noble pursuit be convention, but more often achieved elsewhere.

feats.name: Command
feats.effect:
You Command an Ally to take an Action with an AP Cost up to the amount you spend. Following a Command from you is a !0 AP Reaction.
This Action gains the Primary Quality if the Action you Command is a Primary Action.

feats.name: Bannerlord
feats.effect:
You raise a metaphorical (or literal) Banner. This has a Range equal to your Leadership plus 1.
For the Duration, Allies within Range can Move with you, up to their Movement, when you take a Movement Action.

feats.name: Efficacy
feats.effect: When you Command an Ally, the Action you Command can cost 1 more AP than you spend, so long as you spend at least 1.

feats.name: Warning
feats.effect: When an Ally within Range of your Banner is Attacked, you can grant them Resistence_All up to your Leadership as a !0_AP Reaction.

feats.name: Coordination
feats.effect: Your Command is no longer a Primary Action under any circumstance.

feats.name: Direct Assistance
feats.effect: Allies within Range of your Banner gain a Bonus to a single Test per Turn of your choice, equal to your Leadership.

name: Arcane Magic
summary: Before the Cataclysm, magic was breath. The Aether, an omnipresent background of Arcane potential, allowed the Gifted to freely draw on its power. When the World shattered, so did the Aether. Most of it became estranged, uncontrollable, manifesting as dangerous, Shard-wide Anomalies. The other crystalized into Residue, the fuel that provides the Cities with breathable air, powers Arcane Artifacts,

runes.name: Star
runes.group: The Rudimentary Runes of Arcane Magic
runes.effect: You create a point of light within your Influence. It can be Linked to a Space, Creature or Object. When Linked, it can be locked into a relative Distance relation up to T Meters, and can be made to rotate about the Target Linked to, up to 3T Meters per Round. Engaged Creatures are Blinded by its brightness if its Tier exceeds theirs'.

runes.name: Spark
runes.group: The Rudimentary Runes of Arcane Magic
runes.effect: You manifest a small, fleeting ember at your fingertips, hot enough to burn. This deals Incendiary Damage to something you Touch, with a Base Damage equal to the Tier of the Spell.

runes.name: Shell
runes.group: The Rudimentary Runes of Arcane Magic
runes.effect: You conjure a shimmering Magical Aura up to T Meters around a Target within your Influence, Linking it to them. This region always counts as part your Influence, regardless of distance. When Linked to a Mage whose Reach is less than half the Tier of this Spell, they cannot Channel.

name: ARCANE
summary: The Discipline of Mages, used to develop their facility with Arcane Runes.
text: The Discipline of Mages, used to develop their facility with Arcane Runes.

feats.name: Wyrd Hunger
feats.effect:
When you Generate Aether, you gain more, up to half your Training in Arcane. This can only be done once per Turn.
Further, in lieu of Generating, you can consume one Plug to gain one Aether (as a 1 AP Interaction). 10 Plugs per Day is enough to mimic the effects of food and water for you, for consecutive Days equal to your Arcane.

feats.name: Focus
feats.effect: Pick a single Class, Spells which you Cast with Runes from that Class always count as 1 Tier higher and are 1 step Easier to Cast.

feats.name: Less and More
feats.effect: Whenever you Generate Aether while already holding more than your Reserve, you shed as much Strain as AP spent. Likewise, you automatically detect the presence of Magical effects within your Influence.

runes.name: Void
runes.effect: You automatically Generate Aether up to half the Tier of the Spell (minimum 1) at the start of each Turn. However, you must roll a Chaos Die for each, suffering Persistant Strain for each 6.

runes.name: Weight
runes.effect: When Cast, something you Touch becomes heavier or lighter by 2T. Something with negative Weight falls up instead of down.

runes.name: Velocity
runes.effect:
You create a Burst within your Influence with a Radius up to T. Creatures within it are subject to one of the following effects, chosen when you Cast the Spell:
At the start of your Turn, roll a Chaos Die. On face 6, you gain an AP. At Tiers 3 and 6, you can roll additional Dice.
You are Stunned for a third of the Spell's Tier (min 1).

runes.name: Presence
runes.effect: A Creature within your Influence gains or loses Reflex, up to T. These effects stack.

runes.name: Density
runes.effect: The Durability or Reserve of a Target within your Influence increases or decreases by T.

runes.name: Distortion
runes.effect: Spaces up to 5T fill with random distributions of materials from a source in your Influence. These are not properly real, and vanish when the Spell ends, but they do obstruct Movement and Detection as normal.

runes.name: Force
runes.effect:
Target something in your Influence and choose one of the following effects.
You move the Target up to 3T in total, in any direction/s, so long as it does not leave your Influence.
You move the Target up to 5T, only in a straight line, but the destination can be outside of your Influence. If the Target collides with something over the course of this, both suffer Blunt Crushing Damage. Cast at Tier_2 this is no longer Blunt, and each greater Tier makes the Damage more Vicious by one.

runes.name: Growth
runes.effect:
Spells from this Rune only effect living things you Touch and in the following ways, depending what they are:
The Target may shed T Strain but, when the Spell ends, must roll as many Chaos Dice, suffering Persistant Strain for each 6 rolled.
It surges to life and takes a form you choose (which must still fit the loose normal range for the plant). Among other uses, these rapid movements can be used to form tendrils which allow you to Interact up to T Meters away using the plant. When the Spell ends, the plant instantly dies and crumbles to dust. Likewise, this robs the plant of any wholesome nutritional value it had.

runes.name: Mimesis
runes.effect: You adopt the exact shape and form of a living Creature within your Influence as long as its Tier is less than T. This changes everything but your Mind and Training. You are considered Channeling for the Duration of this Spell, and imperceptibly so to all but means of detecting Magic, but cannot Cast anything with a Tier greater than that of the Creature.

runes.name: Negation
runes.effect: Target an Active Spell or other Tiered Magical effect within your Influence. If its Tier is less than your Spell's, it ends if it is a Spell or other ambient Magical effect. Magical Items lose their supernatural properties for the duration.

runes.name: Eye
runes.effect: You can percieve anything within your Influence by a supernatural Sense. However, anything you Detect or Target in this way can feel your presence as a prickly, unnatural sensation.

runes.name: Distance
runes.effect: Spaces up to T within your Influence have their Terrain Difficulty increased or lowered by up to 3T. Negative Difficulty causes a Creature to gain Movement when they pass through them (but they can only benefit from such a Space once per Round).

runes.name: Touch
runes.effect: Two Spaces no more than 2T Meters away become Co-incident. This means that Creatures occupying one, occupy both for the purposes of Engagement and Interaction.

runes.name: Else
runes.effect: A Target within your Influence gains a weak ability to perceive the recent past and near future This confers a Bonus of T to Preemption as well as the ability to know what happened in a Space they Detect within the last T Minutes.

runes.name: Echo
runes.effect: An event within your Influence such as a single Action repeats, as long as it was no more than T Simple-Turns in the past. All associated rolls and random event are re-rolled, and the local timeline is reset back to that point. This rolls back Initiative and erases all consequences of that event and all following it. The backlash of this Spell is very strong, and makes you Stunned_3 you for T Full-Turns after Casting it.

runes.name: Size
runes.effect: Something within your Influence changes in Size, by up to T Meters in total. This change does not distort the form of a thing and applies evenly. This effects the Weight as well, by 10 Bulk per Meter.

runes.name: Cohesion
runes.effect: Touch an Object, if its Hardness is less than T plus your Influence, it is destroyed and reduced to dust. You can effect up to 10T Bulk or T Spaces worth of a substance at once with this Spell.

runes.name: Heat
runes.effect: Choose a Target in your Influence, in a Radius of up to 2T around it, Extremity from Heat or Cold is increased or decreased by T.

runes.name: Gravitation
runes.effect: You Touch a Target whose Weight is no greater than 10T, and choose a Point (an Object, Creature, or Space) within your Influence. The Target instantly falls towards that Point as if that were its down-direction. If the Target collides with anything on its way 'down', it both suffers and inflicts the Falling Damage to whatever it hits. Then, it either stops or the obstruction is broken/gives way, and the Target resumes its fall.

runes.name: Death
runes.effect: Anything living that you Touch suffers Chaos Damage, Blunted if Cast less than their Tier, more Vicious for each in excess of their Tier. The Undead shed T Strain instead. If you are not Undead, you suffer 1 Corruption.

runes.name: Entropy
runes.effect: A living Creature within your Influence instantly Risks Minor Panic from pain. If their Tier is less than this Spell's by 1, they Risk Moderate Panic instead, Major for more.

runes.name: Control
runes.effect: Target an active Spell or Tiered Magical Effect within your Influence. If this Spell's Tier exceeds that of the Target, you can exempt any currently effected Targets, and re-orient the effect to Target something else, provided that the new Target is valid for the effect.

runes.name: Manifestation
runes.effect: You instantly replicate the effects of a Ritual you know, provided the Tiers of the component Runes do not sum to a number greater than the Tier of this Spell and you provide any necessary materials and Reagents.

runes.name: Acceleration
runes.effect: As a Reaction, you can halt any Action as long as its AP cost does not exceed T/3. You can also halt a moving projectile, a falling Creature, or other moving object within your Influence, provided its Weight does not exceed 10T. Halting something in the air keeps it levitating there for the Duration. Levitating Creatures are Restrained until they touch the ground or the Spell ends.

runes.name: Locality
runes.effect: Choose up to T Spaces within your Influence. All of them become Co-incident, further, Creatures in one of these Spaces may exit from any other, as if teleporting.

runes.name: Possibility
runes.effect: Choose a Spell with a Tier up to half the Tier of this Spell. Under a specified condition of your choice when Casting this Spell, the chosen Spell is Cast automatically. The Possibility Rune cannot refer to itself. Further, the conditional Spell you create is a Magical Effect with its own Tier, Linked to you, which can be Detected and Negated.

runes.name: Relativity
runes.effect: You are able to dynamically warp time within your Influence. Doing so allows you to take up to T AP from one or more Creatures and give it to another, provided their Tiers are less than this Spell's and you do no transfer more than T AP. AP given in this way can allow the beneficiary to exceed the normal limit of 3 to a Round.

runes.name: Substance
runes.effect:
You transmute up to T Bulk of something you Touch into a different compound. All such changes obey the following laws:
The resultant compound is always less pure than the original. Metal can never become a gem, silver cannot become gold, but any metal can become dirt, and a gem can become gold. This almost directly means that the transmutation depreciates the Value of the product.
The product must be of the same "state" as the ingredient under current conditions. Stone cannot become water, but ice can become some kinds of stone. Relative changes in Hardness should not exceed 2T.
The product is never more "reactive" than the ingredient. Black powder could be made into sand, and acid could become saltwater, but not the inverse. Likewise, the Substance Rune alone cannot make something edible or from something poisonous and the nutritive principle of the product is always less than the ingredient. In the acid example, brackish saltwater can be produced, but not freshwater. Conversely, milk could become water, but not vise versa.

runes.name: Collision
runes.effect: Up to 1+T Objects or Creatures within your Influence become unable to interact with eachother at all, one phasing through one the other as if were not there. Expanses of a substance T Meters or smaller count as an Object for this purpose.

runes.name: Lightning
runes.effect: A Target within your Influence is struck by an arc of power, inflicting Voltaic Damage. When it hits, roll T Chaos Dice, if any comes up 6, the nearest Creature to the Target is struck, and you roll one less Chaos Die. This procedure repeats until it fails to produce a 6, or no Dice remain. The same Target cannot be struck twice by the same Spell.

runes.name: Sun
runes.effect: At a Space in your Influence, a blisteringly bright light appears, accompanied by deadly furnace blasts of fire. Everything within a Radius of it up to 10+3T Meters is Blind and subject to 3+T Extreme Heat and those Engaged directly 6+T Extreme Heat (Incendiary Damage is suffered at 6, which is more Vicious for each greater step).

runes.name: Antilife
runes.effect:
You create a surge of necromantic energy that has one of the following effects of your choice:
An Undead Creature within your Influence fall under your verbal control if their Tier is less than this Spell's.
A Creature whose Tier is less than T and has died within 1 Minute returns to life as a Mindless Undead.
Unless you are Undead, using this Spell also inflicts T/2 Corruption on you.

runes.name: Regeneration
runes.effect:
Touch a Creature, they shed Injuries depending on the amount of Aether spent (in Casting or afterwards with persistent Touch). You may continue to spend Aether for T Rounds thereafter for this purpose.
So, a T6 Regeneration Spell could instantly heal a Minor Injury, and would provide a subsequent 6 Rounds after Casting to supply more Aether for a greater, or additional Injuries. E.G., a Creature with a Minor and Moderate Injury could be fully healed with one T6 Spell followed by 10 more Aether spent.

name: BINDING
summary: Of the many strange abilities derived from the Abyss, the Binding Pact is the most recognizable. A power of the Principality of Greed, Binding Pacts leverage the Souls of the mortals who swear them. During the Conquest, the Arch-Demons used this power, initially, to Bind traitors to their cause. This is the same reason why some few of them survived Abaddon's defeat.

feats.name: Blood Sight Invokation
feats.effect: By spending 1 Minute and 1 Corruption, you can transfer your vision to your Imp's, allowing you to see what it sees. This does not Blind you, but your eyes remain in their disturbing state until you you dismiss this Invokation.
feats.flavor: Lesser Spirit, chain of my link, in my hands I take your vision, and with it, Bind mine

feats.name: Invokation of Minor Banishment
feats.effect: As 1 AP Interaction, you Touch your Imp and Banish it. While Banished, your Imp is nowhere at all. You can call it back to your Engagement with the same Action. By suffering 1 Corruption, you can also call it back to another destination within Meters equal to your Binding times 10.
feats.flavor: Impure one, little spark of Hell under my command, I adjure you to the netherworld, to return only at my call.

feats.name: Invokation of Lesser Life
feats.effect: As a 0 AP Reaction, you can instantly kill your Imp, shedding Strain equal to its Tier, including Persistant Strain. You can also forgo this effect on Strain and suffer 3 additional Corruption to remove 1 Injury of any Severity from yourself.
feats.flavor: Feeble Spirit, over whom I am master by rite of election, I take your life, and with it, augment my own.

name: Athletics
summary: Dynamism and release, Athletics directs and controls bodily force. While not necessarily making one strong, it gives the strong new and powerful ways to use their strength.

attrs.passive:
You gain Bonus to your Encumberance equal to your Athletics, can use Athletics to Roll.
For the Duration of this Stance, you gain a Bonus to your Movement equal to your Athletics, and can Leap equal to your Movement. When you Leap and make an Action Test or Attack, you gain a Boon.

passive:
You gain Bonus to your Encumberance equal to your Athletics, can use Athletics to Roll.
For the Duration of this Stance, you gain a Bonus to your Movement equal to your Athletics, and can Leap equal to your Movement. When you Leap and make an Action Test or Attack, you gain a Boon.

feats.name: Warmed Up
feats.effect: For the Duration of this Stance, you gain a Bonus to your Movement equal to your Athletics, and can Leap equal to your Movement. When you Leap and make an Action Test or Attack, you gain a Boon.

feats.name: Knee Drop
feats.effect: When you land from a Fall in Engagement with one or more Creatures, a succesful Roll applies the Damage to one of them, knocking them Prone if it Injures them.

feats.name: Tackle
feats.effect: When you pass through a Creature's Engagement while Sprinting, you can make an Opposed Athletics Test against them as a !0 AP Movement Action, knocking them Prone on a success. A success also negates any Attacks of Opporunity from them.

feats.name: Falling in Line
feats.effect: When you knock a Creature Prone, you can displace horizontally them a number of Meters up to your Athletics. Further, whenever you forcibly move a Creature and they would collide with another, the second is knocked Prone.

feats.name: Sky High
feats.effect: Leap up to twice your Movement without Provoking Attacks.

feats.name: Relentless Rush
feats.effect: Move thrice without Provoking Attacks. Each Creature whose Engagement you pass through is knocked Prone.

name: Span
summary: Span instructs its adepts to wait and strike when the moment demands. Primarily a dedication to the Polearm, it still has lessons for almost any warrior.

attrs.passive: If you have not taken a Movement Action in the same Round, Tests against you suffer a penalty equal to half your Degree of Span (Min 1).

text: Span instructs its adepts to wait and strike when the moment demands. Primarily a dedication to the Polearm, it still has lessons for almost any warrior.
passive: If you have not taken a Movement Action in the same Round, Tests against you suffer a penalty equal to half your Degree of Span (Min 1).

feats.name: Mountain Guard
feats.effect: For the Duration, you are unable to make Attacks except Attacks of Opportunity. However, Enemies Provoke Attacks from you when they enter your Weapon's Range (including the conditional, extended Range of Polearms.) or Attack an Ally.
feats.flavor: Steady, pensive, like a rock at the edge of a cliff.

feats.name: Warding
feats.effect: When you Attack a Creature with a Polearm, their Movement is cut in half and they are Off_Balance for 1 Full-Turn.

feats.name: Deft
feats.effect: The penalty from extending the Range of a Polearm is only 1 for you.
feats.flavor: It's about the grip in the hand

feats.name: Cutting the Rigging
feats.effect: You can use the Range of your Weapon to Trip (Including the extended Range of Polearms), and can substitute the Skill Test with a Melee Attack.

feats.name: The Falling Stone
feats.effect: When you make an Attack of Opportunity, you can treat the Strike as if you had spent 3 AP.

feats.name: Steel Across the Sky
feats.effect: Make a 1 AP Strike with the maximum Range of your Polearm, ignoring the accuracy penalty. If you succeed, you can make another with an Accuracy penalty of 1. If this succeeds, you can make another with a penalty of 2, and so on until you miss.

name: Whirl
summary: The Cleaver is a merciless Weapon designed to cut indiscriminately. Whirl is the Discipline of weaving those cuts into a spinning circle of death.

attrs.passive: Feats in Whirl require the use of a Cleaver or Axe unless otherwise stated.

text: The Cleaver is a merciless Weapon designed to cut indiscriminately. Whirl is the Discipline of weaving those cuts into a spinning circle of death.
passive: Feats in Whirl require the use of a Cleaver or Axe unless otherwise stated.

feats.name: Cleave
feats.effect: Whenever you make a Melee Attack, you can select additional Targets, up to your Training in Whirl, within Range. All Targets must be unique.

feats.name: Sidewinder
feats.effect: For the Duration, you can move an additional Meter when you Maneuver. Further, if you Attack directly after taking a Movement Action, your Cleaver counts as Heavier, up to the Meters moved, for the purpose of dealing Rending Damage.

feats.name: Cutoff
feats.effect: When subject to a Melee Attack, you can make one of your own against them as a 1 AP Reaction. Instead of dealing Damage, this lets you Maneuver before their Attack resolves, potentially putting you out of their Range.

feats.name: Full Moon
feats.effect: Move and Strike. Everything within Range is subject to this Attack. Injury Risk provoked by this Damage is rolled with a Bane.

feats.name: Backswing
feats.effect: When you miss with a Melee Attack, you can Target something else within Range as a !0 AP Reaction. This cannot be the same Target or Targets.

feats.name: Harvest Gleam
feats.effect: When you execute a Full Moon, you can increase your Weapon's Range by T and suffer an additional point of Strain.

name: Cascade
summary: An endless barrage of glinting missiles. Practitioners of Cascade are masters of the Knife, specifically of its use in throwing.

attrs.passive: When Attacking with a Knife, you can Blunt its Damage to count the Attack as a General Action.

text: An endless barrage of glinting missiles. Practitioners of Cascade are masters of the Knife, specifically of its use in throwing.
passive: When Attacking with a Knife, you can Blunt its Damage to count the Attack as a General Action.

feats.name: Slingers Gate
feats.effect: For the duration, Throwing a Knife does not Provoke Attacks unless the Target is Engaged, you can add twice your Cascade to the Range of Knives when Thrown.

feats.name: Endless Supply
feats.effect: When you Throw a Knife, you can draw and Equip another for 0 AP. Further, you can make a free 1 AP Strike with a Knife, before or after Throwing one.

feats.name: Pinpricks
feats.effect: When a Creature is hit by a Knife you release, it Sticks whether or not it Injures them. Each Stuck Knife makes them 1 more Vulnerable, and takes a 1 AP Interaction to remove.
feats.flavor: Go for the heart, settle for the shoulder

feats.name: Sweet Release
feats.effect: When you Throw a Knife, you can Consume all Stuck Weapons (dropping them from the Target after this Attack is resolved) to double their Vulnerability from Stuck Knives.

feats.name: Missed?
feats.effect: Even when you miss a Target with a Thrown Knife, it still Sticks.

feats.name: Blood Hail
feats.effect: You Throw a Knife.

name: Honor
summary: A strict Discipline of martial prowess, Honor is the ancient test of will and body, coordinated in the smooth arc of time.

attrs.passive: Feats of Honor require a Saber, unless otherwise stated. Your Attacks of Opportunity deal more Damage, up to your Honor.

text: A strict Discipline of martial prowess, Honor is the ancient test of will and body, coordinated in the smooth arc of time.
passive: Feats of Honor require a Saber, unless otherwise stated. Your Attacks of Opportunity deal more Damage, up to your Honor.

feats.name: Parry
feats.effect: When subject to a Melee Attack, you can make a Potence Test with a Difficulty equal to their roll as a 1 AP Reaction. If you succeed, their Attack fails and they Provoke an Attack from you.

feats.name: Fluidity
feats.effect:
For the Duration of this Stance, you gain a Buff of 1 to Potence Tests and can choose one of the following optional effects when you Parry:
Even if you fail, you can Blunt the Damage unless it is greater than your Honor.
The Potence Test is rolled with a Bane and the foe does not Provoke an Attack, but the AP Cost is reduced to 0.
The Potence Test is rolled with a Bane, but you can attempt to Swipe the Foe's Weapon as part of the same Action.
feats.flavor: Flexible as a river, lighter than air

feats.name: Precision
feats.effect: Sabers are more Vicious for you by one.
feats.flavor: Know the design of your enemy, foreknow their demise

feats.name: Slipstream
feats.effect: When you Maneuver, you can spend an additional AP while passing through a Creature's Engagement to force them into Provoking an Attack from you.
feats.flavor: Honor is a tree, it bows before the wind which slays the inflexible.

feats.name: Deflection
feats.effect: When a foe misses you with a Melee Attack, you can redirect it, making something else other than the foe within its Range the Target.

feats.name: Sunrise
feats.effect: Make an opposed Potence Test against a foe within Melee Range. If you succeed, they Provoke an Attack from you and become Stunned for 1 Round. Repeated use increases the Tier of this Condition up to 3.
feats.flavor: Honor is a contest, a lethal comparison of skill

name: Tumble
summary: Once an impractical art, Tumbling is a deadly serious practice for Expeditioners. When terrain, threats, and hazards are totally unknown, speed and avoidance are some of the mightiest shields.

attrs.passive: You have a Buff to your Movement equal to your Tumble.

text: Once an impractical art, Tumbling is a deadly serious practice for Expeditioners. When terrain, threats, and hazards are totally unknown, speed and avoidance are some of the mightiest shields.
passive: You have a Buff to your Movement equal to your Tumble.

feats.name: Drive
feats.effect: You Maneuver plus your Tumble in any direction at all. When you Drive though a Creature's Engagement, you can attempt to Trip them.

feats.name: Slip
feats.effect: When you pass through a Creature's Engagement, they become Vulnerable equal to half your Tumble for one Turn.

feats.name: Tumbler's Grace
feats.effect: For the Duration, you do not Provoke Attacks at all, gain a Climbing Speed equal to your Walking Speend, and suffer less Damage from Falling, equal to twice your Tumble.

feats.name: Continuity
feats.effect: When taking a Movement Action, you can take a different Action during the Movement without stopping.

feats.name: Limitless
feats.effect: All Difficult Terrain is reduced for you by your Tumble, and you can cling to flat surfaces seemingly without handholds when Climbing.

feats.name: Beyond
feats.effect: When you Drive, you can pass through anything but total iron-clad obstructions, such as Meter-thick walls of metal. Anything short of it and seemingly absurd gaps are enough for you to pass through.

name: Brawling
summary: Hand to hand combat was not looked on favorably in the past, lacking in sophistication. Now, most Verdun outside of the Nobility have little stigma around the concept. In fact, Brawling as a Discipline is a popular sport, as well as a training regime for Expeditioners inclined to learn it.

attrs.passive:
Your Unarmed and Improvised Weaponry become more Accurate, equal to your Brawling. The former is never Blunt, and has a minimum Damage of 1.
For the Duration, Damage against you is less Vicious by half your Brawling (Min 1), and your Unarmed and Improvised Attacks are more Vicious by the same amount.

For the Duration, Damage against you is less Vicious by half your Brawling (Min 1), and your Unarmed and Improvised Attacks are more Vicious by the same amount.

feats.name: Square Up
feats.effect: For the Duration, Damage against you is less Vicious by half your Brawling (Min 1), and your Unarmed and Improvised Attacks are more Vicious by the same amount.

feats.name: Combo
feats.effect: You can make a number of 1_AP Unarmed or Improvised Strikes up to one plus your Brawling.

feats.name: Pivot Kick
feats.effect: Maneuver and make a 1_AP Unarmed Strike as a part of the same Action. Hitting the Target allows you to displace them in any direction by up to half your Brawling. This Distance is increased if your Unarmed Attacks are Powerful.

feats.name: Reverberation
feats.effect: Each time you hit a Creature with an Unarmed Strike, you leave a Pressure Point for 1 Minute, making them Vulnerable to you for 1 Minute.

feats.name: Pile-Driver
feats.effect: When a Creature is airborn/Falling within Meters equal to your Brawling, you can Leap to their Engagement and make a 1_AP Unarmed or Improvised Strike. If this hits, you both return to the ground and the Falling Damage Tier is added to that of your Strike. Your own Falling Damage is negated by successfully Pile-Driving.

feats.name: Full Sequence
feats.effect: You Consume all the Pressure Points of a Target in your Engagement and can execute a Combo with up to 8 Strikes, every Strike gains Boons equal to the number of Pressure Points Consumed. Any of these Strikes can be Pivot Kicks or Pile-Drivers, ignoring their usual limitations.

name: Bulwark
summary: Expertise in the use of the Shield, a Discipline of Paladins and protectors. This is often viewed as an essential exercise for any swordsman, and a vital element of Training as a Nobleman or Paladin.

attrs.passive:
When you Block with a Shield, it suffers less Durability loss, equal to your Bulwark.
You have an extra AP each Round, exclusively used to Block.

feats.name: Iron Stance
feats.effect: For the Duration, Damage against you is less Vicious by half your Bulwark, Shields gains the same Bonus to their Durability, and you cannot be Moved against your will except by blows that would instantly Break your Shield.

feats.name: The Line of Duty
feats.effect:
When an Ally within Meters equal to your Bulwark is Attacked, you Leap towards them and Block the Attack if you enter Engagement.
This Action counts as a Block.
feats.flavor: Everyone stands together, lest we fall divided

feats.name: Retribution
feats.effect: When you Block an Attack, the Attacker Provokes one from you if they fail to Break your Shield.

feats.name: Reflection
feats.effect: You can Block Ranged Attacks, provided the projectile is mostly physical, with any Shield. If they fail to Break your Shield, you can reflect the Attack to another Target within Meters equal to your Bulwark.

feats.name: Perfect Resistance
feats.effect: When you Block an Attack which fails to Break your Shield, the Attacker loses all remaining AP.

name: Crush
summary: Brutal, slow, effective. The Discipline of Bludgeons. Crush is simplistic, its only function to destroy.

attrs.passive:
All Bludgeons you Wield gain or increase their Powerful Quality, up to half your Crush. Likewise, these Weapons suffer no Durability Loss unless you Block with them.
Strike with a Bludgeon. The Target you hit it is Stunned for 1 Round and, if they would collide with something, the Damage is more Vicious for each Meter moved.
You are Off_Balance and Vulnerable for one Turn after using this Action.
You negate the Conditions applied to you by this Action.

feats.effect: Strike with a Bludgeon. The Target you hit it is Stunned for 1 Round and, if they would collide with something, the Damage is more Vicious for each Meter moved.

feats.name: Moving Mountain
feats.effect: For the Duration, you gain a Bonus to Attacks with Bludgeons, equal to the number of Meters moved in the previous Action. Further, When you Block with a Bludgeon, Durability loss is reduced by half your Crush.

feats.name: Skyward
feats.effect: If a Target is repelled up by an Attack from you which also Injures them, they are knocked Prone.

feats.name: Predatory Instinct
feats.effect: Attacks made against Targets suffering from more than one Condition are made with a Boon.

feats.name: Impending Doom
feats.effect: When you spend at least 3 AP Striking with a Bludgeon, your Critical Success range is expanded by half your Crush.

feats.name: Unstoppable Force
feats.effect: When you hit a Target with your Skull Cracker, they are repelled an additional number of Meters equal to your Crush. (This has no effect on the Powerful value.)

name: Iron Will
summary: An entirely mental Discipline, but hardly academic. Iron Will is the practice of strength, control, and resistance. Adepts of the Iron Will can become more than fearless, as a lack of fear is folly, masters of their own mind.

attrs.passive:
When you roll Panic Risk, you can reduce the Pool by one.
For the Duration, your Reserve is greater by one and you may ignore effects that target your Mind unless their Tier exceeds the same.

feats.name: Tempering
feats.effect: For the Duration, your Reserve is greater by one and you may ignore effects that target your Mind unless their Tier exceeds the same.

feats.name: Feedback Loop
feats.effect: Whenever you suffer Panic Risk and do not Panic, you can shed 1 Strain.
feats.flavor: The branch bent without breaking is made stronger

feats.name: Necessary Evil
feats.effect: When suffering from any Condition, you can negate it, no Action required, at the cost of 1 Persistent Strain.
feats.flavor: My failures will not define me

feats.name: Steel Mind
feats.effect: When you would become Incapacitated or Unconscious, roll a Chaos Die. On faces 1-5, you ignore the cause. Each time you do this the range of success decreases by 1 for the rest of the Day.

feats.name: Quenching
feats.effect: You can voluntarily suffer Panic Risk of any Severity. If you do not Panic, you shed Strain and your Allies gain any benefits against Stress and Panic that you have for 1 Full-Turn

feats.name: Diamond Mind
feats.effect: For the next Minute, your Reserve is greater by 6, are immune to Panic, and invulnerable to any attempts on your mind, but you suffer 2d6 Persistent Strain at the conclusion of this Action.

name: Sharpshooting
summary: Archers wield lethality, a tools useful only for reaping. Noble in some respects, many Verdun still regard Sharpshooting with some mixed feelings. Killing from a distance can appear cowardly, and the sheer efficiency of a Trained Sharpshooter can appear almost malicious.

attrs.passive:
You can add your Sharpshooting to Ranged Attacks with a Bow.
For the Duration, your Movement is 0, but you can Reload Bows for less AP, up to your Sharpshooting and your Ranged Attacks are more Vicious by one.

feats.flavor: Draw with the breath and release

feats.name: Sighting
feats.effect: You can Gauge a Target to make them Vulnerable, up to half your Sharpshooting, to you for one Turn.

feats.name: Lethal Insight
feats.effect: When you hit a Vulnerable Target with a Ranged Attack, your Weapon is one more Vicious.

feats.name: One Follows Another
feats.effect: If you Injure a Target with a Ranged Attack, you can make another for !0 AP. Its Damage is Blunted.

feats.name: Rain in Winter
feats.effect: You knock several Arrows at once, up to twice your Sharpshooting, firing a Volley within Range. This Creates a Burst, with Radius up to your Sharpshooting. Each Creature within it must roll a Chaos Die. On faces 4-6 they are struck by your Bow.

feats.name: Ice Storm
feats.effect: You can fire multiple Volleys at once when you use Rain in Winter, suffering 1 Strain for each. Volleys do not overlap for Damage, but Targets within multiple Bursts roll as many Chaos Dice and take the highest result.

name: Wisdom
summary: Rarest of Disciplines, issuing from an unknown origin, lost in the Doom. Wisdom is not a spiritual practice, is not an art, and is not even properly a Discipline, in truth. Wisdom is a mentality, one that, when cultivated, can be formed into a weapon against the unreal.

feats.name: Emptiness
feats.effect: When under a Magical Effect of any Kind, if its Tier is less than or equal to your own, it does nothing. For effects without apparent Tiers, like some Rituals or Magic Items, use that of its maker.
feats.flavor: Gone, Gone, Gone to the other shore

feats.name: Shroud
feats.effect: For the Duration, Your effective Tier for Emptiness is increased by half your Wisdom, and you can spend AP to directly remove any Condition, 1 AP for Minor, 2 for Moderate, 3 for Major, etc. You can also do this as a Reaction to receiving the Condition, and enter this Stance even when Unconscious.

feats.name: Negation
feats.effect: When you would be Injured or Panic, you can suffer 1 Persistant Strain to ignore the cause.

feats.name: Release
feats.effect: While under the effects of Magic of any kind, you can suffer 1 Strain to suspend the effect for 1 Full-Turn.

feats.name: Joy
feats.effect: When you Rest, you automatically shed 1 Corruption.

feats.name: Nothingness
feats.effect: For the Duration, your resistance to Magic applies to everything with an Aura centered on you, with Radius equal to your Wisdom.
feats.flavor: There is nothing without cause, and so in truth there is nothing

name: Alchemy
summary: Tonics, Medicines, and other less reputable kinds of substance existed long before the Doom. With the advent of the Expeditionary age and of the confinement within the Arks, it would hardly take a prophet to predict their proliferation.
text: Tonics, Medicines, and other less reputable kinds of substance existed long before the Doom. With the advent of the Expeditionary age and of the confinement within the Arks, it would hardly take a prophet to predict their proliferation.

feats.name: Mutagenic
feats.effect:
In addition to the normal array of Items, Chemists are known for a select array of special concoctions known as Mutagens. A Mutagen is made from a Creature's own blood, mixed and adulturated for less than natural effects.
A Mutagen only effects the Creature whose blood was used as an ingredient, but Mutagens lack a Cost for Brewing, provided the blood is obtained without a material Cost. Likewise, when you Brew a Mutagen, its Tier is equal to the value of any Numerical Bonuses it provides, up to your Alchemy.

feats.name: Stimulating Vapors
feats.effect: When Brewing, you can package a Consumable as a Bomb. A Bomb is a Light Weapon that deals no Damage. Instead, every Creature within a T-Meter Burst from where it lands when Thrown is effected by the Consumable at half its normal effect in terms of Buffs, Bonuses, or the Addictive and Deadly Qualities. Mutagens function at half their Tier as Bombs.

feats.name: Sickly Regrowth
feats.effect: You can Brew a Vulnerous Decoction as a Mutagen for a Creature with an Injury. When Consumed, they can ignore the effects of Injury (including Permanent effects) for a Day but suffer 1 Corruption.

feats.name: Wakeful Medicine
feats.effect: You can Brew a Quickening Tonic as a Mutagen. This allows a Creature's to add your Alchemy to their Reflex for Initiative for the next 24 Hours and removes their penalties from lack of sleep. After the duration, they suffer the effects of 2d6 missed nights of sleep.
feats.flavor: This will bring you up, for now

feats.name: Doctor's Orders
feats.effect: When Brewing, you can make any Consumable at all as if it were a Mutagen, but this only effects the Creature whose blood you used.

feats.name: Monstrous Adaptation
feats.effect: Your Mutagens can effect anyone, regardless of the blood used. When under the effects of another's Mutagen, the patient suffer 1 Corruption. Further, you can twist any of your Mutagens when Brewed, inverting the benefits into penalties.

name: Artifice
summary: The Doom required advancement and, with the introduction of Residue, provided a new kind of fuel for development. Artifice is a Discipline that blends Magic and craftwork, creating otherwise impossible works.
text: The Doom required advancement and, with the introduction of Residue, provided a new kind of fuel for development. Artifice is a Discipline that blends Magic and craftwork, creating otherwise impossible works.

feats.name: Flexibility
feats.effect: By spending 10 Minutes in Interaction, you can Tune a Magic Item, making it more efficient. For a number of Uses equal to your Training, it uses 1 less Plug. If it already used only 1, then every other use is free for half that number of uses.

feats.name: Physical Intellect
feats.effect: Automata that you create are more capable of performing complex tasks. When you issue it a Command, the Command can include more than one Action or conditionals, of possibly different kinds. Moreover, they can recognise Creatures by their name and kind, allowing for Commands like "Go there and Grab that Verdun" or "Shoot that(points to a Target) or Follow me if you cannot".

feats.name: Wonder Worker
feats.effect:
Even without your intervention, your Automata develop to the point of being able to act of their own accord, in a very limited fashion. You gain the following three Directives you can use for Commands.
Under this Directive, an Automaton can be given a loose description of a thing and embark on its own to find it. In this capacity, it will defend itself and procure the Target before returning to the original location. Given their lack of real understanding, expect vague expectations to be met with proportionately ambiguous results.
Under this Directive, an Automaton acts in the defense of a Creature, place, or thing you designate. This can include keeping someone from leaving a location, protect a thing from being taken, or following and protecting you, etc. Its behavior will be analogous to a simple animal protecting a territory or charge.
Under this Directive, an Automaton will perform a general task, such as digging around a pillar, moving debris from one place to another, or unloading an Airship, etc. It can make basic judgements about that is satisfactory, but any kind of nuance will be guarenteed to produce odd or incomplete results.
feats.flavor: When the toy excels its maker

name: Surgery
summary: Injuries, especially the more grievous, have been with the Verdun likely before there were Verdun. Then and now, Hospitallers are the usual refuge against these. However, secular means exist for preference or of necessity. Barbers are the experts of these means, would surgeons of another time and place filling a distinct role within the Shard Sea.

feats.name: Splints and Poultices
feats.effect: When you use First-Aid, you can treat the Test as a Specialized Surgery Test. If you succeed by 3 or more, the Target sheds 1d6 Strain.

feats.name: Hands of a Surgeon
feats.effect: As a !0 AP Action you can administer a Consumable to an Ally within your Engagement, or yourself.

feats.name: Killing Time
feats.effect: When using First-Aid, you can Maneuver, make an Interaction, Strike, or Shoot as a part of the same Action, as if with 1 less AP as used for the First-Aid.

feats.name: Pick-me-up
feats.effect: Creatures you give First-Aid automatically shed Strain equal to half your Surgery, and you can end any Condition they are suffering from (including Exception Conditions) of your choice.

feats.name: Saintly
feats.effect: When a Creature dies, you can attempt to perform First-Aid with a Difficulty of 16. If you succeed, they are only Unconscious. This only works if the Target only "died" within Simple-Turns equal to or less than your Surgery. Likewise, Creatures that die due to a lethal instance of Damage are not effected.

feats.name: Just a Scratch
feats.effect: When you give a Creature First-Aid, they can ignore the effects of any but a Major Injury for 1 Minute.
feats.flavor: Keep off it for a week

name: Hunting
summary: Ancient as life, the Discipline of seeking life to take and gather. Hunters would have been a kind of Maker before the Doom, walkers of the wilds and a valuable source of food and goods. Now, the Shard Sea is the only hunting ground which remains, a grander and more dangerous place than any field or wood of lost Gaia.

attrs.passive: When Harvesting, you can substitute the value of your Hunting for Traversal for all purposes. When Surveying, you also learn more about the local Fauna than others. For example, at least one Species you might encounter, regardless of your roll.

feats.name: Pitfall
feats.effect:
By spending 1 Minute, you can leave a Snare in a Space or Spaces. This has one of the following effects when a Creature first enters it:
The victim is knocked Prone and Restrained until they untangle themselves for 3 AP.
The victim suffers Cutting, Piercing, or Crushing Damage.
The Snare makes a loud noise.
The Snare produces the effect of an Interaction in the same Space or an Adjacent Space.
Creatures do not automatically see your Snares. Finding one requires a Test against your Hunting.

feats.name: Hunter's Awareness
feats.effect:
You are always passively aware of the kind of Creatures within a Kilometer of you, as well as the relative number (Eg. tens, hundreds, thousands, etc.) Likewise, when you Gauge a Creature, you can treat them as having a greater Weakness according to their kind:
Only you benefit from this Weakness, which is equal to the Creature's Tier.

feats.name: Instant Ambush
feats.effect: When Initiative begins, you can put yourself at the top of the Turn Order, but you suffer 1 Strain at the end of that Turn.

feats.name: Killing Move
feats.effect: When you Attack a Creature before they act in the Turn order, you can treat all of their Vulnerabilities as twice the normal value, and they roll their Injury Risk with a Bane.

feats.name: Fast Setup
feats.effect: You can lay a Snare instantly, but suffer 1 Persistant Strain.

feats.name: Harvest Moon
feats.effect: When you are the first Creature to act in a Round, your Critical Success range for all Tests is greater by half your Hunting.

name: Scavenging
summary: The Shard Sea is a waste, full of detritus and cast offs and lost things. Scavengers are the experts in finding, adepts of making much of very little. As such, many Expeditioners pick up at least a little Training here.

attrs.passive:
Your Encumberance is increased by your Scavenging, as is the value you can create when Scrounging.
You have an amount of Resources equal to twice your Scavenging. Under the circumstance where you need an Item or would benefit from it, could have plausibly obtained it and transported it to your current location, you can produce it, spending as many Resources.
Producing an Item retro-actively applies all the conditions under which it would have been obtained, including incumbrance and cost. If you could not have acquired it for these or other reasons, you cannot produce it.
Your Resources replenish whenever you visit an Ark or when you Scrounge, which restores Resources up to the Opportunity Cost.
