feats.flavor: I wish we'd thought of that

feats.name: One Eye Open
feats.effect: You gain 1 free AP when rolling Initiative, which you may spend on any Action or save for Reactions, in addition to any Agility.

feats.name: Emergency Use
feats.effect: You can over-draw from your Resources. This inflicts Persistent Strain equal to the difference and depletes them until you reach an Ark or Outpost.

feats.name: Helpful Reminders
feats.effect: When you use your Deep Pockets, you can use an Ally's circumstances instead of your own, at the cost of 3 additional Resources.

feats.name: Playing Possum
feats.effect: You can Coin-Flip to apply the benefits of One Eye Open to any kind of Unconsciousness, Incapacitation, or other limitation on your mental awareness other than death.

feats.name: All the Time in the World
feats.effect: You can spend Resources to gain extra AP.

name: Scouting
summary: Search and discovery are incredibly valuable talents. Scouts are iconic Expeditioners, able to move quickly over long distances and keep an eye on a multitude of threats.

attrs.passive: Your Reflex is increased by half your Scouting, and you can Survey as a Scouting Test.

text: Search and discovery are incredibly valuable talents. Scouts are iconic Expeditioners, able to move quickly over long distances and keep an eye on a multitude of threats.
passive: Your Reflex is increased by half your Scouting, and you can Survey as a Scouting Test.

feats.name: Ear to the Ground
feats.effect:
When you Gauge a Creature, you can leave a Trace on them. A Trace allows you to generally intuit their current location at any time. You can also Indirectly Gauge Creatures by studying tracks, dropped Items, or other leavings no older than twice your Scouting in Hours.
Traces have a Duration of 24 Hours.

feats.name: Scout Conditioning
feats.effect: You gain an Increase to your Climbing Speed, equal to twice your Scouting and, when above a Creature, can visually Spot and Gauge them from as far away as a Kilometer.

feats.name: Found You
feats.effect: Traces can be Consumed to automatically Spot a Creature. When you do so, you gain a Bonus equal to your Hunting to Tests against them for the next Full-Turn.
feats.flavor: Right where I knew you would

feats.name: Wirey
feats.effect: You can ignore Difficult Terrain if its Tier is less than your Scouting. Likewise, when not on Difficult Terrain, you gain half as much as a Bonus to your Movement.

feats.name: Caught Out
feats.effect: When you Consume a Trace to Spot a Creature, your Attacks against them cannot miss, and Tests made against them that succeed by more than 3 critically succeed.

feats.name: Omnipresence
feats.effect:
You always know where a Traced Creature is, all your Senses including hearing and Smell are as good as Vision for the purpose of Targetting them. Likewise, all Tests against them are easier by 1.
When you would Consume a Trace, you can spend one more AP, or suffer 1 Strain to keep it instead.

name: Assassin
summary: An Ancient Discipline, the art of taking life. Assassins are at home in the dark, ready to spring at a moment's notice.

attrs.passive: You can add your Assassin to Attacks against Creatures that do not Detect you.

text: An Ancient Discipline, the art of taking life. Assassins are at home in the dark, ready to spring at a moment's notice.
passive: You can add your Assassin to Attacks against Creatures that do not Detect you.

feats.name: Sneak Attack
feats.effect: Move for 0 AP, up to your Movement and Strike, Throw, or Shoot for at least 1 AP. Both of these are combined to one Action for Sneaking.

feats.name: Surprise
feats.effect: When you Damage a Creature that does not Detect you, they become Stunned for Rounds equal to your Assassin.

feats.name: Tainted Strikes
feats.effect: You can transmit any Poison via an Attack, regardless of its normal transmission modality.

feats.name: Lethal Jolt
feats.effect: When you Strike a Creature that does not Detect you, they fall Prone.

feats.name: Killers Intuition
feats.effect: Against Creatures that do not Detect you, Major Injuries are lethal.

feats.name: Mortal Blow
feats.effect: When you succesfully Attack a Creature, you can suffer 1 Persistent Strain to expand your Critical Success range. You can do this as many times as you wish for the same Attack, potentially turning into a critical success after rolling.

name: Guile
summary: Liars are never popular, at least not when you know them. Otherwise, they run the show. While hard to sympathize with and easy to scorn, the Liar is a useful ally when things go bad.

attrs.passive:
You can add your Guile to the roll when you Preempt.
Creatures with Mind less than yours are Gullible for you. You have a Boon to Impress them, two if you're lying.

feats.name: Silver Tongue
feats.effect: Creatures with Mind less than yours are Gullible for you. You have a Boon to Impress them, two if you're lying.

feats.name: Liar's Sense
feats.effect: When speaking with a Gullible Creature, you can loosely infer whether or not a lie is plausible to them, learning their Attitude, asking the GM before you'd Deceive them.

feats.name: Countercharm
feats.effect: If a Creature is lying to you, you know, just not what about. You can also treat Scrutiny as a Darkness Activity to find that out.

feats.name: Internal Rehearsal
feats.effect: You can Retract something you said within the last number of Seconds equal to twice your Guile. This retro-actively removes the sentence from the game entirely and replaces it with something harmless.

feats.name: Sly
feats.effect: You can infer Attitude even if the Target isn't Gullible.

feats.name: Subversion
feats.effect: A Gullible Creature you Communicate with must spend 1 AP doing whatever you wish, so long as it does not literally harm it, like a self-Attack. Walking into a hazard does not count as literal self-harm.

name: Skullduggery
summary: The Discipline of the Thief. Pickpockets and burglars alike practice Skullduggery, as well as Expeditioners, when the need arises.
text: The Discipline of the Thief. Pickpockets and burglars alike practice Skullduggery, as well as Expeditioners, when the need arises.

feats.name: Slight of Hand
feats.effect:
You can Conceal an Item or Items on your person, with no more Bulk than your Skullduggery. These cannot be perceived by normal means, but edge cases like a cavity search or Magic might.
Objects Concealed by Slight of Hand can be Transfered, as a 1 AP Interaction, and doing so prevents the Targeted Creature from knowing they the Concealed Object now resides on their person.
You can also Conceal an Object in another Creature's possession as an Interaction with an AP cost equal to half its Bulk. If they do not Detect you, and the Object is not in their hands, they do not notice the loss.
All uses of Slight of Hand count as Interactions.

feats.name: Dodge
feats.effect: When Attacked, you can Maneuver away, potentially leaving its Range or blocking line of sight.

feats.name: Continuity
feats.effect: When you make a Stealthy Movement Action, you can include a Stealthy Interaction at any point in the Movement without stopping.

feats.name: Flash
feats.effect: You create a diversion which hides you from all Senses for the next Simple-Turn.

feats.name: Blink
feats.effect: You vanish entirely, intangible but unable to Act until the start of your next Turn. At such a time you emerge, you can be anywhere within Meters from the original Space up to your Skullduggery

attrs.passive: Your Mind is increased by half your Memory.

feats.name: The Mind Palace
feats.effect:
You have an internal memory model, your Mind Palace, that aids in memorizing things that others simply couldn't. Your Mind Palace allows you to record the exact contents of anything that could be written, drawn, or painted on a Page of average size. Something that would take multiple of these can still be Memorized, but fills multiple Pages in your Mind Palace.
You have a number of Pages in your Mind Palace up to twice your Memory, all of which start Blank. Filling a Page takes approximately 1 Minute of scrutiny of the thing you wish to Memorize. This makes the Page full, even if the entirety isn't consumed.
If all the Pages in your Mind Palace are full, you can over-write any of them you choose when Memorizing.

feats.name: Rushed Approach
feats.effect: By suffering Strain, you can hasten the process of Memorization. This reduces the time needed to Memorize to 6 Seconds, or a 3 AP General Action.

feats.name: Hardware
feats.effect: You can externalize your Mind Palace, allowing you to replicate one of its Pages on a real Page in the same amount of time. Physical Pages can be used to add or remove things from your Mind Palace without loss of any information.

feats.name: Brute Force
feats.effect: When attempting to remember something not in your Mind Palace, you can make a Difficulty 16 Memory Test. If you succeed, the information is gained as Pages. If you fail, you cannot attempt this again for 24 Hours for the same information.

feats.name: Continuity
feats.effect: If you have a physical Page from your Mind Palace on your person, you can treat it as if it were a mental Page.

feats.name: The Second Mind
feats.effect: Your Mind Palace's Page limit is doubled.

name: Scholarship
summary: Intellectuals and practical researchers alike practice the Discipline of Scholarship; not the study of a subject, but the investigation of knowledge itself.

attrs.passive:
When you Study, a failure by a margin equal to or less than your Scholarship still results in you learning whether the answer exists in a given Source.
All kinds of information can be grouped under a Subject, a species of knowledge. Relative to any Subject, you have a Grasp, which quantifies your past academic experience with a Subject.
Your Grasp of a Subject allows you to automatically answer certain Questions without needing to Study, recalling it from your mental library.
When you gain this Feat, you can choose to increase your Grasp of two Subjects by 1. Further, when Gauging a Creature whose Tier is equal to or less than your Understanding of a Subject that studies it, you automatically succeed.
Your Grasp can never exceed thrice your Tier, and, when you Study, if the Sources have a reasonably comprehensive depth, you can increase your Grasp of a Subject by spending 3 or more Opportunity.

feats.effect: Each time you Study a Subject, you gain a temporary Buff to your Grasp of it, equal to half the Opportunity spent. This Buff decays by 1 each Day.

feats.name: Domain Knowledge
feats.effect: If your Grasp of a Subject which studies a Creature is greater than their Tier, you always have an Opening for them.

feats.name: Instruction

feats.name: Coordination

feats.flavor: You go left, I go right

feats.name: Prediction
feats.effect: You make a verbal (out loud) Prediction about an Enemy, such as "they will Attack (so and so)" or "you will Interact with (such and such)". If they follow your Prediction, they become Off_Balance for 1 Full-Turn.

feats.name: Group Action
feats.effect: Members of your Plan gain a Boon which they can spend on Test made for its Duration.

feats.name: Call Out
feats.effect: When your Prediction is successful, the Target Risks Minor Panic. If they already were the Target of a successful Prediction, this is Moderate instead.

feats.name: Double Time
feats.effect: When you Execute a Plan, you can Coin Flip to keep it, instead of Consuming the Plan.

feats.name: Demoralize
feats.effect: When your Prediction is successful, you can Taunt them as a 1 AP Reaction. Taunting an Enemy provokes Minor Panic Risk from them, regardless of how many times you have already Predicted them. Each Taunt after the first increases the Severity of this Risk.
